about: The communio of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: On the last day of the feast Jesus said: Rivers of living water will flow from within the one who believes in Me. Now this He said of the Spirit whom those who believed in Him were to receive, alleluia, alleluia.

a.g: On the last day of the feast
those who believed in Him were to receive

ex.w014: Jesus promises that rivers of living water will flow from within the one who believes in Him.
